dataset_source: synthetic-v1; product x intent; held-out query templates; shared corpus
limitations: Closed-corpus synthetic query-template benchmark, not evidence of pretrained or real-world accuracy.
Training sees corpus text and train queries only; dev/test labels never enter training.
Scores are retrieval-only; no LLM generation is performed.

comparison_training.mining: uniform without replacement, excluding all positives

negative_strategy_ablation.limitation: A single small synthetic run does not establish a general advantage; compare several seeds and independent data before a general claim.
